description: This file defines classes and functions for handling paginated data, including search, sorting, and query string generation, specifically for the 'PageLink' and 'TimePageLink' classes used in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: PageLink
classes.description: Represents a paginated link with search and sorting capabilities, including methods to generate query strings, sort data, and paginate.

classes.name: TimePageLink
classes.description: Extends PageLink to include time range filtering with startTime and endTime properties.

methods.name: defaultPageLinkSearchFunction
methods.description: Returns a search function that filters entities based on a search property and text.

methods.name: sortItems
methods.description: Compares two items based on a specified property and sort order.
